banner.title: TABLE 54 (TYPES OF ARMOR & ENCUMBRANCE), printed capture p. 95 - the OA armor encumbrance round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the page - the 23-row grid cross-checked cell-by-cell between the two passes; the base weights and the base movement rates agree in both passes - zero numeric contested cells. The contests are textual: the bulk classes read non/fairly/bulky in the print against the compressed non-/fairly/bulky (the trailing hyphen a cell-edge artifact, the print read stands); the kote weight cell reads blank in the print against the compressed dash - both read no base weight given, the -99 sentinel carries it; the movement glyph reads prime (feet) in the print against the compressed double-prime (the feet read stands, the numeric column strips the unit). The banded and chain plus-after-pound marks print as 35# + and 30# + (the R640 plus-after-prime class, riding the comments). The armor type names and the bulk classes are textual and ride the column comments per the T48 doctrine; the movement dash cells (the buckler, haidate, kote, the two shields, the sode pair and the sune-ate) pin as -99. The armor descriptions prose box stays open; Table 55 (capture p. 98) is deliberately left for the next round
